name: Octolane
description:
Revenue superintelligence built for modern sales and go-to-market teams. This connector lets Claude read and manage your entire revenue workflow.

Pipeline & deal management: Search deals, get full deal details, create new opportunities, move deals through pipeline stages, and get instant pipeline overviews with deal counts and total values. Create and customize sales pipelines, stages, and custom fields on the fly.

Contacts & accounts: Search, create, update, and enrich contacts and companies by name, email, domain, industry, or job title. Bulk create or update up to 50 records in one request.

Email & meetings: Search email threads with any contact or account, schedule emails for future delivery via your connected Gmail, and pull full meeting transcripts and attendee lists to prep for calls or write follow-ups.

Tasks, notes & activities: Create tasks linked to deals, contacts, or accounts; log calls, meetings, and LinkedIn touches; and keep notes attached to the right records.

Website visitor intelligence: Identify companies visiting your website with Octolane Signal and turn anonymous traffic into pipeline.

AI memory: Octolane stores your ICP, sales process, pricing, and writing style as structured memory, so Claude's outputs match how your team actually sells.

Ask Claude things like "which deals are stalled in negotiation," "prep me for my 2pm meeting," or "draft follow-ups for every demo this week."

_published_faq.name: How do I add Octolane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Octolane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.octolane.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Octolane MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Octolane lists 69 MCP tools, including bulk_create_accounts, bulk_create_contacts, bulk_create_deals, bulk_delete_account_fields, bulk_delete_accounts, bulk_delete_contact_fields, bulk_delete_contacts, bulk_delete_deals, bulk_delete_notes, bulk_delete_pipeline_fields, bulk_delete_stages, and bulk_delete_tasks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Octolane?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Octolane in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Octolane requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Octolane is developed by Octolane. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
